features.label: width: x extent
features.description: x_max − x_min of the shower's hits, floored at 10⁻⁶ mm (core.py:470).

features.label: height: y extent
features.description: y_max − y_min of the shower's hits, floored at 10⁻⁶ mm.

features.label: depth: deepest z − 3649 mm (below the front face)
features.description: max(z_max, 10⁻⁶) (core.py:473): the deepest hit's coordinate, not an extent. In the absolute frame it is raw z, quoted below the front face (z − 3649 mm).

features.label: depth range: z extent
features.description: z_max − z_min of the shower's hits, floored at 10⁻⁶ mm.

features.label: volume: width × height × depth
features.description: width × height × depth (core.py:475), with depth the deepest coordinate - raw z in the absolute frame - so it is not a geometric volume there.

features.label: number of hits
features.description: Rows of the shower: one per cell and event.

features.label: total deposited energy
features.description: Σ E of the shower's hits: the deposited energy, not the incident momentum.

features.label: energy-weighted centroid x
features.description: Σ E·x / Σ E (core.py:491-497).

features.label: energy-weighted centroid y
features.description: Σ E·y / Σ E.

features.label: energy-weighted centroid z
features.description: Σ E·z / Σ E; raw z in the absolute frame.

features.label: mean hit radius r
features.description: Mean of r = √(x² + y² + z²) over the hits, in this frame's coordinates.

features.label: SD of hit radius r
features.description: Sample SD (ddof = 1) of r over the hits.

features.label: maximum hit radius r
features.description: Largest r over the hits.

features.label: energy-weighted mean radius r
features.description: Σ E·r / Σ E.

features.label: mean polar angle θ of the hits
features.description: Mean of θ = arccos(z / r) over the hits.

features.label: arithmetic mean of the hits' azimuth φ
features.hatched: An azimuth has no linear correlation: the cells carry Mardia's circular–linear R, or the circular–circular r_c with the other azimuth. The notebook's linear r, which jumps where a shower straddles the ±π cut, is kept beside them for parity only.
features.description: core.py's arithmetic mean of φ = atan2(y, x). An azimuth wraps, so this is not a direction: kept for parity with the producer's file and the XGBoost inputs only.

features.label: mean direction of the hits' azimuth φ
features.hatched: An azimuth has no linear correlation: the cells carry Mardia's circular–linear R, or the circular–circular r_c with the other azimuth.
features.description: atan2(Σ sin φ, Σ cos φ): the circular mean of the hits' azimuths.

features.label: angular spread SD(θ) + SD(φ)
features.hatched: Contains a linear SD of φ, inflated by the ±π cut, so part of its variance is the cut's position rather than the shower.
features.description: core.py:499: sample SD of θ plus the linear sample SD of φ, which the ±π cut inflates for showers near the cut.

features.label: angular spread SD(θ) + circular SD(φ)
features.description: Sample SD of θ plus the circular SD √(−2 ln R̄) of φ: angular_spread without the branch-cut inflation.

features.label: hit density: hits / volume
features.description: num_hits / volume; enormous wherever a factor of the volume is floored.

features.label: energy density: energy / volume
features.description: total_hit_energy / volume; enormous wherever a factor of the volume is floored.

class_sets.windows: The features notebook's momentum windows (1, 2, 5, 10, 19.5) ± 0.5 GeV.
class_sets.bins: The producer's 1 GeV momentum bins (its integer bin column).
class_sets.label: The binary label p < 2 GeV against p ≥ 2 GeV.

notes: Features are rebuilt from the per-shower sums of the event table with core.py's formulas (calc_all_features_v3, raw z), which reproduce the producer's aggregate to 10⁻⁹.
Showers with fewer than 2 hits are left out, as the producer's aggregate leaves them out: 1 in this selection.

avg_phi is core.py's arithmetic mean of the hits' azimuths, kept for parity with the producer's file; an azimuth wraps, so it is not a direction. avg_phi_circ is the mean direction atan2(Σ sin φ, Σ cos φ).

Centroids are energy-weighted (core.py:491-497); std_r and the SDs inside angular_spread are sample SDs (ddof = 1); num_hits counts rows. angular_spread adds a linear SD of φ, which the ±π cut inflates; angular_spread_circ uses the circular SD √(−2 ln R̄) instead.

Depth in the absolute frame is quoted below the front face, z − 3649 mm. The volume, both densities, centroid_z and the radii use raw z, as the producer computed them, so the volume there is not a geometric volume.
core.py floors width, height, depth and depth range at 10⁻⁶ mm; a floored factor makes the volume tiny and both densities enormous.

Momentum classes are the features notebook's windows (1, 2, 5, 10, 19.5) ± 0.5 GeV, half-open; its 20 GeV class is [19, 20) here because every momentum in these files is below 20 GeV. Showers in no window are counted, never drawn.
